images.alt: Announcement square graphic with a light grey background and a dark blue bell icon at the top. Large heading reads ‘ANNOUNCEMENT’. Below, text states: ‘Cremation Regulations 1973 updated to reduce workforce burden and delays.’ At the bottom are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo

post.text:
We have updated New Zealand’s Cremation Regulations 1973 to better reflect modern clinical practice, reduce duplication, and help avoid unnecessary delays for families. 

These changes come into effect 7 May 2026. 
 
More information below (links in comments).
